info.title: codesage-api
info.description: CodeSage AI — an AI-powered software engineering assistant that understands, documents, reviews, and improves GitHub repositories.

get.description: Returns HTTP 200 and a JSON body indicating the service is running. Suitable for use as a liveness probe.

post.description: Create a new user with a unique email and secure password.
Authenticate with email and password to receive a JWT access token.

get.description: Retrieve the profile of the currently authenticated user.
Retrieve all repositories owned by the currently authenticated user.

post.description: Add a new repository to CodeSage AI for the current user.

get.description: Retrieve a specific repository by ID, ensuring owner authorization.

put.description: Modify repository details if owned by the current user.

delete.description: Delete a repository if owned by the current user.

post.description: Fetch public metadata from the GitHub API and persist it on the repository record.  Sets status to 'ready' on success or 'failed' on GitHub error.  The caller must be the repository owner.
Retrieve repository source archive from GitHub, scan and filter files, detect languages, calculate structural metrics, and persist the ingestion result. Caller must be the repository owner.

get.description: Retrieve the most recent ingestion record and structural metrics for an owned repository.
Retrieve all historical ingestion records for an owned repository.

schema.title: Response List Ingestions Repositories  Repository Id  Ingestions Get

get.description: Retrieve a specific ingestion record by ID for an owned repository.

post.description: Perform hybrid (semantic + keyword) retrieval over the indexed codebase of an owned repository.  Returns ranked code chunks with source-location metadata. No LLM generation is performed — this endpoint returns retrieval evidence only.

post.summary: Ask the repository assistant a question
post.description: Ask a RAG-grounded question about an owned, indexed repository. Creates a new conversation when conversation_id is omitted, or continues an existing one owned by the caller and scoped to this repository. Returns a defined insufficient-evidence result rather than an unsupported answer when the repository has no sufficiently relevant indexed code for the question.

get.description: List all assistant conversations owned by the current user for this repository, most recently active first.

schema.title: Response List Conversations Repositories  Repository Id  Conversations Get

get.summary: Get a conversation with full message history
get.description: Retrieve one conversation and its messages in chronological order.

post.summary: Explain a file, line range, or symbol
post.description: Explain a specific part of an owned, indexed repository, grounded in retrieved evidence. Returns a defined insufficient-evidence result rather than a fabricated explanation when no sufficiently relevant indexed code is found for the target.

post.summary: Review repository code and/or user-provided code
post.description: Review code from an owned, indexed repository, and/or user-provided code/diff text (untrusted input, up to 20,000 characters), for a given focus area. Returns structured findings plus a human-readable summary. When the review is purely repository-scoped (no user_code) and no sufficiently relevant indexed code is found, returns a defined insufficient-evidence result rather than a fabricated review.

message.title: Message
message.description: The user's question about the repository.

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: Existing conversation to continue. Omit to start a new conversation for this repository.

AskResponse.title: AskResponse
AskResponse.description:
Response payload for ``POST /repositories/{id}/ask``.

``evidence`` here is the *live* ``ChunkSearchResult`` set returned by
this turn's retrieval (full chunk text, not the bounded snippet that
gets persisted) — see ``ConversationService`` for the distinction.

query.title: Query
query.description: Search query string or code symbol.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Maximum number of relevant chunks to return.

file_extensions.title: File Extensions
file_extensions.description: Filter results by exact file extensions (e.g. ['.py', '.ts']).

file_paths.title: File Paths
file_paths.description: Filter results by file path prefix (e.g. ['app/api/']).

CodeSearchResponse.title: CodeSearchResponse
CodeSearchResponse.description: Complete response payload for a code search query.

ConversationDetailResponse.title: ConversationDetailResponse
ConversationDetailResponse.description: A conversation including its full, chronologically-ordered history.

ConversationSummaryResponse.title: ConversationSummaryResponse
ConversationSummaryResponse.description: A conversation without its full message history (list view).

EvidenceCitation.title: EvidenceCitation
EvidenceCitation.description:
A single soft-referenced evidence citation persisted on a Message.

Deliberately not a foreign key to ``code_chunks`` — see
``app.models.conversation.Message`` for why — so this shape survives
repository re-indexing intact.

file_path.title: File Path
file_path.description: Repository-relative path of the file to explain.

start_line.title: Start Line
start_line.description: Optional starting line of the target range.

end_line.title: End Line
end_line.description: Optional ending line of the target range.

symbol.title: Symbol
symbol.description: Optional function/class/symbol name to focus on.

question.title: Question
question.description: Optional specific question or focus for the explanation.

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: Existing conversation to append this explanation to. Omit to get a one-off explanation with no persistence.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: Response model for the health-check endpoint.

IngestionResponse.title: IngestionResponse
IngestionResponse.description: Detailed response schema for a repository ingestion run.

IngestionSummaryResponse.title: IngestionSummaryResponse
IngestionSummaryResponse.description: Concise response schema for listing historical ingestion runs.

RepositoryResponse.title: RepositoryResponse
RepositoryResponse.description: Schema for repository data returned by API endpoints.

RepositoryStatus.title: RepositoryStatus
RepositoryStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a repository in CodeSage AI.

file_path.title: File Path
file_path.description: Repository-relative path of the file to review.

symbol.title: Symbol
symbol.description: Optional function/class/symbol name to focus on.

user_code.title: User Code
user_code.description: Optional user-provided code or diff to review, treated as untrusted input. Maximum 20,000 characters.

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: Existing conversation to append this review to. Omit to get a one-off review with no persistence.

ReviewRequest.title: ReviewRequest
ReviewRequest.description:
Payload for ``POST /repositories/{id}/review``.

Requires at least one of ``file_path`` (a repository target) or
``user_code`` (untrusted, user-supplied code/diff text) — reviewing
nothing is not a valid request.

TokenResponse.title: TokenResponse
TokenResponse.description: Schema returned upon successful authentication containing the JWT.

UserResponse.title: UserResponse
UserResponse.description: Safe schema for user details returned by API endpoints.
